audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..4].side read 'Skill' while content win[0..4] and packet.levelChart both read Neeko. Five rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: The content layer and the packet agree, so the full layer is the stale one. It is also the defensible reading: Blooming Burst is 800 range on 9s at rank 1 and Tangle-Barbs is 1000 range on 12s, against Azir's 740-range Q on 14s. She trades on cooldown until Nashor's, which is exactly where both charts hand the lane back.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side -> Neeko with all five .why rewritten to match.

audit.why: Her spike is level 6 Pop Blossom (120/105/90s, 600 range, knock-up then stun on landing) and the fact that its preparation is HIDDEN while she is disguised. Azir's are Nashor's Tooth and his own Emperor's Divide on the same 120/105/90.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, phases[4].why and tldr now carry the hidden-wind-up spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to 'sidestep it behind minions'. Tangle-Barbs damages and roots EVERYTHING it passes through — minions do not block it. That is advice that gets a reader rooted.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.' So the wave is not cover, and letting it eat a minion makes the root WORSE. Second interaction: Inherent Glamour breaks on 'receiving immobilizing crowd control' — Emperor's Divide's knock-up is immobilizing, so your R strips her disguise; Sand Soldier slows do not.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[1].why rewritten around the real behaviour; the disguise-strip written into dosFull[2].d and ahead.

notes: CHART: phases[0..4].side were the stale token 'Skill'; content win[0..4] and packet.levelChart already read Neeko, so the full layer was moved onto them and every .why rewritten in this same proposal. No paired win[N] edit exists to propose — win[N] is already correct on disk for all five rows. The packet flags 'level chart contradicts data: Azir wins 54.55% but the chart gives Neeko 5/7 stages'; I did NOT flip the chart to resolve that, because two independent layers agree on Neeko and her ranges/cooldowns support it — a 54.55% win rate off a lane you lose and then out-scale is coherent. SUSPECT NAME: packet flags wants.foe[0] 'Land Blooming Burst' as a probable wrong name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE, Blooming Burst is Neeko's real Q. No edit. Biggest real defect fixed: the page repeatedly said to sidestep Tangle-Barbs 'behind minions'; Riot's text says it roots everything it passes through and grows larger/faster/longer-rooting if it kills a unit, so the wave is not cover and hiding behind it makes the root worse. Deliberately unasserted: whether Sand Soldiers themselves block or absorb the tangle, and whether the disguise breaks to Azir's Q slow — only the immobilise clause is in Riot's text, so only the R knock-up strip is claimed.
